mapper.sql: v.verif_id, v.eco_id, v.lot_id, l.lot_no, v.insp_id, h.insp_no, h.insp_type, v.result, v.status, v.note, v.void_reason, v.created_at, v.created_by, v.row_ver
from qms_setup_verif v join lot_master l on l.lot_id = v.lot_id join qms_insp h on h.insp_id = v.insp_id
mapper.select: select order by v.created_at desc, v.verif_id desc limit #{limit}
select insp_id, lot_id, insp_no, insp_type, result, judged_at from qms_insp where status = 'JUDGED' and lot_id in #{x} order by judged_at desc
select insp_id, lot_id, status, result from qms_insp where insp_id = #{id}

insert into qms_setup_verif (comp_cd, eco_id, lot_id, insp_id, result, note, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ecoId}, #{lotId}, #{inspId}, #{result}, #{note}, #{by}, #{by}) returning verif_id
select count(*) filter (where result = 'OK') as ok, count(*) filter (where result = 'NG') as ng from qms_setup_verif where eco_id = #{ecoId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
